newsitem.title: UK: Budget secret leak shows UK govt arrogance - Lilley.
newsitem.headline: Budget secret leak shows UK govt arrogance - Lilley.

text.p: Conservative Treasury spokesman Peter Lilley on Wednesday accused a government minister who leaked a budget secret of treating parliament with arrogance.
Lilley said the confirmation of a report that the government would end tax relief on private medical care for elderly people could affect markets unfairly.
A senior government minister was early quoted by British media as having said the report was correct well ahead of the budget speech by Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown at 1430 GMT.

"We want to know who that minister was, why he did it, and hold him to account for his actions. It's all part of the arrogance with which this government treats parliament and it has got to stop," Lilley told Sky television.
Lilley said the incident showed the government "puts media manipulation ahead of sound government, sound bites ahead of sound policy".

"The advance release of information to the markets, which can cause major movements in market prices, make some people rich and other people less rich; the release of information to journalists which has not been disclosed to the House of Commons -- these are serious matters," Lilley said.
